evidence.reason: `DEPENDENCY_RE` is the dependency-directive allowlist used by the live-binding scan. Systemd v257 defines `PropagatesStopTo=` and its inverse `StopPropagatedFrom=` as stop-propagation dependencies in `[Unit]`; omitting them lets a co-installed unit that can stop the selected service be missed, so discovery can incorrectly report `supported=True`. This is an implementation gap in the existing dependency scan, not a proposal to enlarge protection scope.
